title: RateZip U.S. Consumer Finance Open Datasets (Savings Tax Hurdle, 53k .gov Auto Quotes, 126-City Equity)
subtitle: 50-State CD vs. Treasury Tax Hurdle, 53,685 Official State .gov Auto Insurance Quotes, and 126-City Mortgage Readiness Data
description: Public, reproducible U.S. consumer finance datasets published by RateZip (https://www.ratezip.com). Includes: (1) 50-state + DC CD vs. 1-year Treasury state-tax hurdle table (https://www.ratezip.com/data/savings-gap), (2) 53,685 official quotes from 10 state department of insurance databases (https://www.ratezip.com/data/auto-insurance-study), and (3) 126-city post-2021 homebuyer equity and mortgage readiness table (https://www.ratezip.com/data/mortgage-readiness-cities-2027). Full methodology at https://www.ratezip.com/methodology; live unauthenticated MCP endpoint at https://mcp.ratezip.com/mcp.
